ratios.label: Earnings per share
ratios.withheld_reason: Withheld: the twin keys EGS60101C010 and EGS60101C010.CA are one issuer and published eps for this period (4.78 against 5.502381). The key backed by the issuer's own filing keeps the figure; this key's conflicting value is removed so one issuer does not carry two.

valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: EBIT and net debt are not both on file for FY2025, so EV/EBIT cannot be built. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pegFormula: P/E divided by the growth rate of earnings, the growth rate expressed in percent
valuation.pegGrowthBasis: net profit compound annual growth of 31.79 percent a year from FY2022 (1.74905e+09) to FY2025 (4.00344e+09), over 3 years
valuation.peEpsSource: net profit for FY2025 divided by the shares on file
valuation.pbFormula: current price / book value per share, where book value per share = total equity / shares outstanding
valuation.pbEquityRow: total_equity on the balance sheet for FY2025
valuation.pbSharesSource: the same 7.27139e+08 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_EGX.json)
valuation.psFormula: current price / revenue per share, where revenue per share = revenue / shares outstanding
valuation.psRevenueRow: the income statement's revenue line for FY2025, read from the row labelled 'Revenue'
valuation.psSharesSource: the same 7.27139e+08 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_EGX.json)
valuation.peCrossCheck: differ by 9%: market cap 15330000000 used (price x shares) vs 16804185294 on file

derived.ytdBasis: year to date from the last close before 2026 (2025-12-31, 15.39) to the price on 2026-10-05
